faq: Do I need engineering for my retaining wall?
Walls over 1 m need engineering. We arrange it, and we deal with your local council, including preparing and submitting plans for approval.
We're based in the Adelaide Hills at Mount Barker and service all areas across South Australia.
Yes. No job is too big or too small, from a backyard wall to large civil and commercial projects.
How do I get a quote?
Call 1300 123 367 between 9 am and 5 pm weekdays, email info@affordableretaining.com.au, or send the form on the contact page. Quotes are free.
